From the Grub-Street Journal. VII. A Question by Anonymous

T
ELL,
 if you can, which did the worse,
Caligula or Gr[afto]n’s Gr[a]ce?
That
 made a Consul of a horse,
And 
this
 a Laureate of an ass.
